A [[Stolen Sunspear Armor]] can be used to change a single [[hero]]'s armor set to a hero version of [[Elite Sunspear armor]]. To change a hero's armor, speak to [[Bahldasareh]] in [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]] while that hero is in your party.

Only [[Nightfall]] [[hero]]es who do not have [[Mysterious armor]] or [[Ancient armor]] available to them are eligible for this armor:

*[[Acolyte Jin]]
*[[Acolyte Sousuke]]
*[[Dunkoro]]
*[[Koss]]
*[[Melonni]]

==Acquisition==
*[[Kourna]]
**[[Dajkah Inlet]] 
***[[Corsair Guild Lord]]
:::<small>''Item has a chance to be placed directly in each player's inventory each time a Guild Lord is killed.''</small>

==Notes==
*Once a hero has been given at least one alternate set of armor, you can switch between any of their unlocked sets at any [[hero armorer]]s corresponding to that hero.
*A hero must be wearing one of their alternate armor sets to be displayed in the [[Monument of Fellowship]] in the [[Hall of Monuments]].
